ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) central field comprising approximately 70% of the surface area, contrasted against high-intensity (white) distal fields comprising approximately 30% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white fields are localized to the distal thirds of both fluke lobes. These regions contain irregular low-intensity focal spots and linear streaks; the right lobe distal region exhibits a higher density of dark spotting compared to the left.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped notch with an internal vertex angle of approximately 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary along the trailing edge characterized by irregular peaks and valleys (amplitude 5-15 pixels), with the highest frequency and amplitude of variations occurring at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge geometry follows a sigmoidal curve, initiating as concave near the median notch and transitioning to a convex sweep toward the outer lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark, irregular pixel clusters present at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, though distinct circular rosette geometry is partially obscured by dark pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear pixel streaks (rake marks) are visible traversing the high-intensity white regions of both the left and right lobes, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, dark protrusions and jagged material adhering to the distal extremities of both lobes.
